verdict.rationale: Grok Build ships its own extension mechanism: a TUI Marketplace tab for browsing and installing plugins from configured sources, plus reusable skills that surface as slash commands, so third-party agent extensions can be brought into workflows. Nothing in the pack establishes a partner-built agent app ecosystem or vetted partner catalog, so only the plugin/skill marketplace counts here. MCP tool integration is a different story and is not credited. missing for 10: evidence of a partner program or curated third-party agent apps, documentation of how partner-built agents are packaged and distributed, independent or hands-on corroboration of installing third-party plugins.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows

citations.quote: The TUI includes a Marketplace tab for browsing and installing plugins from configured sources.
Skills are reusable folders containing markdown instructions, script files, and resources for agents.
User-invocable skills also appear as slash commands, for example `/<skill-name>`.
